commands.command: TBD: expand M115 boundary relocation search over more source pairs, geometry offsets, or matched-pair cohorts until M116 diversity gates can pass
commands.name: m117_source_diverse_wrong_history_boundary_mining

decision_rule: Proceed to objective training only if a broader wrong-history boundary surface passes the M116-style diversity gates across physical source pairs, decision steps, and normal-margin buckets.
failure_criteria: accepted rows remain limited to fewer than 6 physical source pairs
accepted rows remain limited to one normal-margin bucket
wrong-history success drops appear only after over-tightening one geometry family
M62 control becomes admitted as a wrong-history surface
hypothesis: M116 rejected M115 because the surface is duplicate-dominated. A broader source/geometry search may find a less tuned wrong-history outcome surface suitable for training.
success_criteria: accepted wrong-history success drops cover at least 6 physical source pairs
accepted rows cover at least 2 normal-margin buckets
M62 remains a control with zero accepted wrong-history rows
the result decides whether M118 should train a boundary-aware wrong-history objective
